data_source_policy: v7 curated W7-X/W7-AS vs tokamak profile/transport proxy; full FR8 evidence requires matched machine-readable profile/transport tables.

falsification_logic.caveat: PDF/plot-only sources leave FR8 data_limited, not null.
falsification_logic.confirm_like: Matched stellarator/tokamak profile tables show stellarator edge transport proxy closer to the predicted KSS-like limit after normalization.
falsification_logic.falsify_like: Comparable public profile/transport rows exist and the stellarator proxy is not closer or is reversed.

prediction_names: stellarator edge transport closer to KSS than tokamak edge transport

profile_proxy_protocol.interpretation: profile_only_proxy_available is readiness, not confirmation; full evidence needs stellarator and tokamak rows in comparable units.
profile_proxy_protocol.minimum_columns: device/device_type, radius or normalized flux coordinate, Te/Ti or ne profile, and heat-flux/diffusivity/transport normalization

source_funnel_policy: v7 curated-source-only; article/PDF prose is not evidence; only structured CSV/XLS/JSON/DAT tables count
